thread:
hao: starting bring-up of lykos21b-int4 on dedicated canary. intermittent OOMs under mixed chat+summarize traffic. suspect fragmentation + prefetch interaction. anyone seen weird slot compaction patterns on 21b int4?

mira: saw similar with a 21b flavor last month. fragmentation tends to blow up when long system prompts + one or two long generations are microbatched together. do you have a failing log?

hao: pasted node log:```
[2026-02-07T08:21:11Z] OOM: alloc 65536 failed at slot_allocator.cpp:187
stack: slot::alloc -> prefetch::ensure_window -> runtime::handle_stream -> model::generate
mem_used=63.5GB mem_limit=64GB free_chunks=28 largest_contig=0.68MB kv_slots=1589
```

sam: largest_contig < page_size; classic fragmentation. quick mitigation we use: per-model max_new_tokens reduction + prefetch softcap + adaptive microbatching when long gens present.

oliver: two quick experiments to propose: (A) reduce default max_new_tokens to 300 for lykos21b; (B) set prefetch_max_pages=30; (C) microbatch cap drop to 4 if any request in batch requests > 200. Apply to 10% canary.

mira: also consider compact-on-evict but gated by free_chunk_watermark (only run if free_chunks < 120) to avoid CPU churn. compact-on-evict coalesces adjacent free slots and fixed similar OOMs for us.

hao: i ran a small repro (100 runs, mixed prompts): baseline -> 9 OOMs. with prefetch_max_pages=30 + microbatch cap 4 -> 1 OOM. p99 latency increased ~180ms for long gens only. short gens unaffected.

sam: nice. we should guard prefetch heuristic with estimate_new_pages = ceil(max_new_tokens / tokens_per_page). If estimate_new_pages > prefetch_max_pages -> skip prefetch and mark request as long-gen.

oliver: +1. also add a per-model default override JSON we can feed into rollout:```json
{"model":"lykos21b","overrides":{"defaults":{"max_new_tokens":300},"runtime":{"prefetch_max_pages":30,"microbatch_cap":4,"compact_on_evict":true,"evict_watermark":120}}}
```
apply at 10% and monitor kv_frag and OOMs.

mira: i'll run quality eval (50 QA prompts) comparing lykos21b int4 300 vs int4 512 vs fp16 512 to check for quality regressions from shorter defaults. will measure exact-match, F1, and rouge-L. seeds fixed.

ops-bot: canary patch created: PR #4555 — lykos21b per-model defaults + prefetch heuristic. CI pending.

hao: cool. ops followups: oliver (deploy & smoke), mira (quality diffs), sam (add slot_largest_contig + free_chunk_count to dashboard + alert when largest_contig < 1MB OR free_chunks drops >50% in 10m). reconvene in 30m. :coffee:
